doc.title: Pete Levin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001

title: Closing remarks and thanks
summary: Rowe suggests another interview, Levin offers one on Gil Evans road stories, and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I wish you the best of luck in maybe arriving in Woodstock, and with wherever those future projects take you. It’s been fascinating talking to you. I think we could probably do another one down the road and see where you go. All right?
I could do one just on Gil Evans.
Yes. Well we probably should do that.
Lot of road stories. © Fillius Jazz Archive -21-
Right. All right. Thanks for your time today.
Thank you, Monk, it was great. © Fillius Jazz Archive -22-
